reviewScope: Focused correction of both variants of Lavandula angustifolia and Salvia rosmarinus after feedback about weak single-leaf character. New shoot drawings were compared with InfoFlora/Flora Helvetica and fresh NC State Extension descriptions and foliage photographs, enlarged and at 24/32 px Compact and 48/64 px Detail. The other 346 source SVGs are byte-identical and retain their v2.2 review; a new full botanical review is not claimed.
measurementMethod: Adaptive Bezier flattening in scripts/geometry.mjs. Blade bounds exclude petioles and stroke widths. Axis-aligned extents are recorded separately from oriented dimensions: scripts/measure.mjs estimates length from the farthest contour-point pair and width from the projection perpendicular to that chord. This is an approximation for unlobed blades, not specimen measurement, curved midrib length or a reliable biological ratio for palmate/lobed leaves. No physical scale is implied.
